title: Patrols every day
description: Pillagers will never sleep through patrols
body:
With this datapack
patrols can start as soon as the world is created and will spawn **every 50 minutes** (you can configure this in data/custom/function/tick.mcfunction)

Instead of standing still, patrols **simply walk forward** (to simulate that they are simply passing you by)





*this datapack is made for SurviveTech Renewed modpack, but **feel free** modpackers with this ^^
